organizations.name: VeloraDAO
organizations.description: VeloraDAO oversees Velora, an intent-based trading protocol for decentralized finance that enables crosschain swaps with one-click gasless trading. Built for high-performance crypto trading and composable finance, Velora uses a decentralized agent-based architecture to provide advanced features such as limit orders, Super Hooks, and real-time execution. The protocol aims to drive DeFi participation by offering secure, intelligent, and optimized trading solutions; the VLR token supports governance and staking.
